items.title: Howden Re advises insurers to pair catastrophe models with independent risk analysis
items.summary: Reinsurance intermediary Howden Re has urged insurers and reinsurers to combine updated catastrophe models with independent risk analysis to properly distinguish between actual risk shifts and modelling assumption changes.

items.title: AMNT opens membership beyond MNTs for first time
items.summary: The Association of Member Nominated Trustees has amended its constitution to permit representatives of public and private sector occupational schemes to join as associate members.

items.title: Binance records $4.7 billion in net outflows following cyber theft
items.summary: Crypto exchange Binance faced $4.7 billion in net withdrawals by Monday morning following a major cyber hack.

items.title: Fidelity International launches SICAV version of Global Innovators fund
items.summary: Fidelity International has introduced a SICAV vehicle for its Fidelity Global Innovators strategy, extending access to clients across Europe and Asia.

items.title: Graham Spence to leave JP Morgan American investment trust
items.summary: Investment Week reports that Graham Spence is stepping down as co-portfolio manager of the JP Morgan American investment trust.

items.title: Antares appoints Miles Robinson and Maxine Davis to claims leadership roles
items.summary: Antares has promoted Miles Robinson and Maxine Davis to senior claims positions across its Lloyd's and reinsurance operations.
